import subprocess,hashlib,json
def git(*a): return subprocess.run(["git"]+list(a),capture_output=True).stdout
pins=json.load(open(".ufo/evidence/round-13/expected.json"))["inputs"]
for p in sorted(k for k in pins if k.startswith("tools/")):
    live=hashlib.sha256(open(p,"rb").read()).hexdigest()
    revs=git("log","--reverse","--format=%H","28aeef498cc070c3183271b709bc79d344ff547a..HEAD","--",p).decode().split()
    if not revs:
        print(p,"unchanged since 28aeef4; live==pin:",live==pins[p]); continue
    first=revs[0]
    subj=git("log","-1","--format=%s",first).decode().strip()[:40]
    at=hashlib.sha256(git("show",first+":"+p)).hexdigest(); par=hashlib.sha256(git("show",first+"^:"+p)).hexdigest()
    print(p,"| pin",pins[p][:12],"| live",live,"| first change",first,"(",subj,") at",at[:12],"parent==pin:",par==pins[p])
